units.summary: Adds a setter that appends the new from-selected-series hint to block meta.json Hints if it is missing, then sorts the list. It works like SetStaleSeries and changes what gets persisted in block meta.json.
units.headline: New setter adds from-selected-series compaction hint to block meta
units.reason: Adds a new value to the persisted block meta.json hints, which other tools and Thanos/Mimir consumers read.
focus: Downstream consumers (Thanos/Mimir compactors) that read meta.json hints and may not recognise from-selected-series

units.summary: Adds a predicate that reports whether a block's meta carries the from-selected-series hint. It is used by compactor Write propagation and by inOrderBlocksMaxTime.
units.headline: New predicate checks for from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Simple read-only helper; its callers carry the risk and are reviewed in their own units.

units.summary: New unit test covering the selected-series hint: it is absent at first, setting it is idempotent, and it can co-exist with the stale-series hint.
units.headline: Test for selected-series hint setter idempotence and coexistence
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: Write now copies the FromSelectedSeries hint from the base meta into the new block's meta, the same way it already handles FromStaleSeries. This is how CompactSelectedSeries tags the blocks it produces.
units.headline: Compactor Write propagates selected-series hint from base meta
units.reason: Changes which hints get persisted into block meta.json during block writes.
focus: Hint is propagated only in Write; Compact (merging blocks) drops it, same as the stale hint does today

units.summary: Blocks tagged from-selected-series are now left out of the in-order max-time watermark, the same way out-of-order and stale-series blocks already are. This affects head truncation and compaction decisions that rely on this value.
units.headline: inOrderBlocksMaxTime ignores selected-series blocks
units.reason: Changes the watermark that drives head compaction and truncation decisions.
focus: Callers of inOrderBlocksMaxTime (head compaction start, OOO handling) still behave correctly when only selected-series blocks exist
After a leveled rollup, the hint survives on the new block, so the exclusion still applies to it

units.summary: New test: CompactSelectedSeries skips series that have out-of-order data and still compacts the other series in the same call.
units.headline: Test that selected-series compaction skips series with OOO data
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test: compactor.Write carries the FromSelectedSeries hint from a source block into the block it writes.
units.headline: Test selected-series hint propagation through compactor Write
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test: inOrderBlocksMaxTime reports no in-order block when the only block on disk is a selected-series block.
units.headline: Test inOrderBlocksMaxTime excludes selected-series blocks
units.reason: New test only.
